newsitem.title: FRANCE: France expelling ETA leader to Spain.
newsitem.headline: France expelling ETA leader to Spain.

text.p: France was to expel a suspected former leader of the Basque separatist group ETA to Spain on Tuesday after he completed a prison term in France, public France Info radio said.

It said Jesus Arkauz Arana, alias "Josu Mondragon", was driven from the Fresnes prison near Paris on Monday night to be accompanied back to Spain, where he is wanted on a string of charges. French police declined comment.
Arkauz Arana, a leading member of ETA's military command, has been detained in French jails since 1991.

He was convicted for illegal weapons possession and for criminal conspiracy with a terrorist organisation. An arrest warrant for him was issued in December 1989 after an ETA arms cache was discovered in France.
ETA has killed some 800 people in Spain during a three-decade-long campaign for a separate Basque state.
